column1: # 'same' = an equivalent mutant (the result must NOT change); it documents why. Newlines in old/new are written as \n.
#  gen-codes-start: bl_count[0] only adds bits above bit `len` of next_code[len], which bi_reverse drops.
#  bitlen-overflow-loop: `overflow` counts every node below max_length (leaves and internal nodes), in sibling
#    pairs, so it is always even and `> 0` and `> 1` agree after each step of 2.
#  bitlen-base-ge: extra[0] is 0 in all three extra-bits tables, so n == base gives xbits 0 either way.
#  bitlen-last-bits: a level-1 leaf is never moved by the repair loop, its Len is already 1.
#  blt-index-cond: when index 3 (code 0) has Len 0, the codes 16..18 are the only ones used and index 2 (code 18)
#    or the forced code decides; the mutant ends at the same index.
#  fb-static-le: when static_lenb == opt_lenb, `opt_lenb = static_lenb` changes nothing.
#  scan-guard-other is NOT equivalent: the guard stays in the tree and is part of the dumped state.
#  detect-32-equivalent: n = 31 is block-listed, so the loop would have returned before.
